title: Signature Priority Queue Shedding

title: Signature Token Bucket Admission
description: Admits only requests holding a token; excess is shed with 429 instead of queuing. title: Signature Request Hedging
description: Sends a duplicate request after p99 latency and keeps whichever returns first, shedding the loser. Hedging trades a little extra load for dramatically better tail latency. Cancel the loser and keep the winner
